Jerome Bettis tells Matt and Stak about his 1993 Rookie of the Year season with the LA Rams: walking into the Roxbury in a polo and hard bottoms, ending up in the VIP section with Magic Johnson, Arsenio Hall and Prince, and throwing pool parties every weekend at his rental in Anaheim Hills. Then his mom called him home to Detroit, where the house he’d just bought his parents came with rules, chores and a trash can he had to take out himself, and he credits that move with keeping LA from swallowing him up.
